account_id.description: Account id of the bank account/credit card, etc making payment (not user id)

device_id.description: Device Information for the device initiating the payment. This must be provided for card payments.

ip_address.description: IP Information for the device initiating the payment. This must be provided for card payments.

wait.description: Time in seconds to wait for item response (up to 30). If this value is not provided, it will defaul to 0 and the call will go asynchronously.

callback.description: Address to callback when an internal business system response is received. Path parameters {account} {item} and {uuid} may be used. The value must be URL-encoded. The example value shown here represents the URL https://callback.example.com/assembly/{item}/{account}/{uuid}
